plugins.name: gt-core
plugins.description: Graphictreat team-wide Claude Code skills: agent orchestration patterns (fan-out-fan-in, model-chat, pipeline, stochastic-consensus), collaboration helpers (grill-me), and design-before-code brainstorming with an optional browser visual companion (brainstorming).

plugins.name: gt-engineering
plugins.description: Graphictreat engineering workflow skills: per-repo setup (setup-gt-dev-skills) for issue tracker, triage label vocabulary, and domain doc layout, plus to-product-req for turning a conversation into a published PRD (with opt-in self-contained wireframes + design spec), to-issues for breaking a plan into wireframe-aware tracer-bullet issues, and tdd for a red-green-refactor test-first loop that verifies the real target builds after each step, keeps the tracked issue in sync, and drives ad-hoc change requests through issues end-to-end, and design-taste-frontend for senior UI/UX frontend design-taste rules that override default LLM design biases.

plugins.name: gt-social
plugins.description: Graphictreat skills for social media content generation (x-post-gen, with more platforms to come).
